skill.name: page-cro
skill.description: Analyze individual marketing pages for conversion readiness. Identify clarity, CTA, trust, friction, and objection issues. Prioritize testable improvements.
skill.summary: Score page conversion readiness and prioritize evidence-based CRO improvements.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The only static finding is a false positive: SKILL.md line 141 asks for paid traffic context during CRO diagnosis. The skill is prose guidance for page analysis and contains no code execution, external command use, credential access, prompt injection, or data exfiltration intent.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 141 asks the reviewer to identify paid traffic messaging in a CRO context. It does not instruct system probing, host enumeration, or data collection outside the page analysis.

content.value_statement: Marketing pages often underperform because value, intent, trust, and friction issues are unclear. This skill scores readiness and turns the diagnosis into prioritized CRO recommendations.
actual_capabilities: Scores page conversion readiness across six weighted categories.
Assesses value proposition clarity, CTA focus, message match, trust, friction, and objections.
Classifies pages as high, moderate, low, or not conversion-ready.
Prioritizes quick wins, structural improvements, and testable hypotheses.
Generates headline, subheadline, and CTA alternatives when useful.
limitations: Requires page content, traffic context, or baseline metrics for best results.
Does not run experiments, analytics queries, or heatmap analysis by itself.
Should not replace statistical validation for high-impact changes.

use_cases.title: Audit a campaign landing page
use_cases.description: Find message match, proof, CTA, and friction issues before increasing paid traffic spend.

use_cases.title: Improve a product or pricing page
use_cases.description: Identify weak benefit framing, unclear plan fit, missing proof, and unresolved buyer objections.

use_cases.title: Prioritize page fixes before launch
use_cases.description: Separate foundational conversion blockers from smaller copy and design improvements.

prompt_templates.title: Run a basic page audit
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review for one page with limited data.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this page for conversion readiness. Page type: [type]. Primary goal: [goal]. Audience: [audience]. Page content or URL summary: [content].

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose low conversion performance
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review with traffic and performance context.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze why this page may be underperforming. Include traffic source, current conversion rate, primary CTA, audience intent, and known objections.

prompt_templates.title: Prioritize CRO recommendations
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prioritization for teams planning design or copy work.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Page Conversion Readiness & Impact Index. Score each category, identify the top constraints, and prioritize quick wins versus structural improvements.

prompt_templates.title: Build an experiment roadmap
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning for pages ready for testing.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a CRO roadmap for this page. Include readiness score, recommended fixes, testable hypotheses, expected behavior changes, and primary success metrics.

output_examples.input: A SaaS landing page has one demo CTA, paid search traffic, and weak proof.
output_examples.output: Readiness score: 72 / 100. Main constraints: unclear differentiation and weak proof near the CTA. Recommended next steps: add outcome proof, rewrite the headline, and test a lower-commitment CTA.

output_examples.input: A pricing page asks visitors to contact sales and has many plan features.
output_examples.output: Readiness score: 64 / 100. Testing is not recommended yet. Reduce plan comparison friction, clarify buyer fit, and address procurement objections.

output_examples.input: A blog post gets organic traffic but has a low newsletter signup rate.
output_examples.output: Readiness score: 78 / 100. The CTA is relevant but too late. Add contextual signup prompts, improve benefit copy, and measure signup rate by scroll depth.

best_practices: Provide the page type, primary conversion goal, audience, and traffic source.
Include current metrics or qualitative evidence when available.
Use recommendations as hypotheses, then validate important changes with measurement.
anti_patterns: Ask for cosmetic changes without defining the conversion goal.
Run A/B tests before fixing unclear value propositions or ambiguous CTAs.
Treat the readiness score as a forecast of revenue lift.

faq.question: What pages can this skill review?
faq.answer: It can review homepages, landing pages, pricing pages, feature pages, and content pages with CTAs.

faq.question: Does it need analytics data?
faq.answer: It can start without data, but traffic sources, baseline metrics, and user research improve prioritization.

faq.question: Can it write copy alternatives?
faq.answer: Yes. It can suggest headline, subheadline, and CTA options when copy is a conversion constraint.

faq.question: Will it guarantee higher conversion rates?
faq.answer: No. It provides evidence-based recommendations and test hypotheses, but real outcomes require measurement.

faq.question: Can it decide whether to run an A/B test?
faq.answer: Yes. It flags when testing is premature and recommends fixing fundamentals first.

faq.question: Does it access live websites?
faq.answer: No. It analyzes information you provide through your AI tool.
